verdict_text:
YES

The merge is correct: `delta = B @ A` gives `[2304, 768]`, transposed under `fan_in_fan_out = true` to `[768, 2304]`, scaled by `lora_alpha / r = 2`, accumulated in float32, and written back under the original name, shape and dtype. Only base tensors are in `sd` (the adapter is a separate dict), so no adapter or intermediate tensor reaches the output, and all other tensors pass through untouched. All four required checks are asserted before writing. The greedy packer keeps each shard's tensor data at or below 104,857,600 bytes and, because it flushes the current shard before adding an oversized tensor and again before the tensor that follows it, `wte.weight` (154 MB) ends up alone in its own shard; the index maps every one of the 160 names to its shard file.
